landing.subtitle: Transform fragmented khata notes, UPI slips, cash sales, and wholesale bills into an evidence-backed Financial Visibility Passport.
landing.problemTitle: "Profitable for years, yet nothing a bank can read."
landing.problemSubtitle: The problem is not a lack of revenue or hard work. The problem is that the financial trail is fragmented across personal savings accounts, loose UPI slips, and handwritten bahi-khatas.
landing.problemSavingsDesc: Shop revenue, household groceries, school fees, and supplier transfers all jumbled in a single bank account.
landing.problemUpiDesc: Hundreds of daily UPI QR credits disappear into month-end aggregates without invoice matching.
landing.problemCashDesc: Physical rupee notes exchanged at the counter leave zero digital footprint unless recorded in a daybook.
landing.problemKhataDesc: Credible, disciplined records kept in red cloth-bound registers, but unreadable by standard bank underwriting systems.
landing.problemInvoiceDesc: Paper bills from wholesale distributors filed away in cartons without digital linkage.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: ArthSetu consolidates every scattered financial source into one coherent, evidence-labelled record ready for voluntary institutional review.
landing.dimensionsSubtitle: We never produce a single credit score. Instead, four transparent metrics show institutional reviewers how much of the business is evidenced.
landing.manifestoSubtitle: Honesty is our visual and functional feature.
landing.manifestoNotLoan: NOT a loan application or automated underwriting system. We never approve or deny loans.
landing.manifestoNotScore: NOT a credit scoring engine. We never collapse a merchant's livelihood into an arbitrary three-digit score.
landing.manifestoNotAuth: NEVER claims uploaded bills are third-party authenticated. All evidence is stamped transparently.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to make your micro-business financially visible?
landing.ctaSubtitle: 100% offline-ready. Client-side privacy. Built for Indian merchants.
landing.dukandaarQuote: Trusted by neighborhood kirana stores, garment shops, and daily vendors across India.

passport.title: Financial Visibility Passport
passport.docClassification: Owner-provided business information · Supplementary information for institutional review
passport.legalDisclaimer: This document is a structured compilation of business records provided by the business owner. It does not constitute a statutory audit, credit rating, loan approval, or bank underwriting guarantee. Reviewing financial institutions must perform their own independent appraisal and due diligence.
passport.netCashNote: Inflows minus outflows as recorded. This is net cash movement, NOT commercial net profit.
passport.missingDataDesc: No third-party aggregator feed is active in this offline record. Cash entries are owner-declared; invoices are document-supplied without external bank verification.
passport.graph1Desc: Gross monthly recorded sales partitioned by cash and digital receipts compared with recorded outflows.
passport.graph2Desc: Relative proportion of counter cash versus UPI and bank transfers.
passport.graph3Desc: Monthly procurement and operational spending classified across supplier and store utility categories.
passport.graph4Desc: Customer credit balances outstanding categorized by ageing duration, alongside recorded supplier dues.
passport.graph5Desc: Percentage of trading days with documented records, accounting for scheduled weekly store closures.
passport.graph6Desc: Distribution of transactions backed by supporting invoices versus owner-declared diary logs.
passport.dimDesc: Four independent evaluations assessing visibility depth without collapsing into an arbitrary credit score.
passport.methOwnerDesc: Figures entered directly into the daily daybook by the proprietor without external documentation (e.g. daily counter cash).
passport.methSuppliedDesc: Entries supported by uploaded statement CSVs, distributor invoices, or payment slips. Note: These are supplied by the owner and have not been independently authenticated by third parties.
passport.methAuthDesc: Entries confirmed through direct consented APIs (e.g. Account Aggregator framework). In this demo, this channel is locked at 0% to maintain transparency.
passport.methUnclassDesc: Raw transactions pending categorization. Disclosed separately to prevent misleading revenue assumptions.
passport.integrityNotice: This SHA-256 hash is computed client-side across canonical serialized records to ensure tamper detection.
